registration.statement: Chemical viscosity is counted adjacent-layer momentum-packet exchange whose carrier retains every component, phase, condition and time/space resource. Chemistry owns the composition-bound relation while the momentum carrier is inherited explicitly from Physics. Measured viscosity is exact positive post-seal support; no continuum velocity gradient, Newtonian constitutive equation, Arrhenius/WLF/VFT form, logarithm or fitted coefficient is imported.
registration.title: Exact composition-bound viscous transport law
